title: Romandan Aşk
author: Buse Kudun
description: Nisan Tan dreams of writing a bestselling romantic comedy, but there’s one problem: her own love life is non-existent, and inspiration won’t strike on its own. Her editor tells her, “To write, you must first live.” Then one night, she meets the mysterious Dinçer, and a daring idea takes shape: he will become the protagonist of her novel. As Nisan carefully plans the “perfect dates” for her story, life refuses to follow the script. Unaware of Nisan’s literary project, Dinçer finds himself entangled in a real-life romance brimming with secrets, surprises, and unexpected twists. How long can Nisan keep her muse, and her heart,under control?
